news.title: Lola Brown: My journey to Chelsea
news.title_zh: 洛拉·布朗：我的切尔西之旅
news.body_en: When you talk to Chelsea Academy graduate Lola Brown, it’s difficult to believe that she’s still only 18. She speaks with maturity well beyond her years, but still has a youthful glint in her eye. It’s clear she’s hungry, and with a calm head to match, she’s ideally placed to soak up everything she needs to learn from the senior professionals at Chelsea. That, alongside her natural ability on the pitch, means the reasons for offering Brown a three-year contract extension are evident. During the domestic Treble-winning campaign of 2024/25, she made her senior debut for the Blues, and after a loan spell at Crystal Palace last season, she’s loving life back in SW6. ‘Football means absolutely everything to me,’ she smiles. ‘When you wake up in the morning, you have something to strive towards. It's always given me a purpose, and I'm also very competitive, so it drives me to want to win. ‘It’s more than just the matchday, though. It's the day-to-day. Every single day you're going for something. That’s why it means everything.’ Perhaps part of the reason for Brown’s mature outlook is the experience of a childhood spent on foreign shores. She began her school life in Malta, where she remained until the age of eight, before her parents returned to England. Two years later, the youngster secured a place in the Chelsea Academy. ‘My parents just went over to Malta, sort of like a getaway,’ she explains. ‘They went for two years, but ended up staying for 14 because they loved it so much. I was born there and then lived there till I was eight. I actually absolutely loved it there. Malta is a massive part of who I am; it’s where I grew up. I owe a lot to Malta, in terms of my early stages and making me who I am as a person. ‘My whole family loves sports. We were all really competitive and driven when I was young, which massively shaped me as a person. The people I had around me in those early years really embedded good morals that I want to live by. ‘I always played football with my brother in the garden in Malta. He’s six years older than me, but when I'd beat him 1-v-1, he'd just pick me up! I would get a bit annoyed because I'm not sure that's part of the rules... ‘At the age of four or five I started playing football at school. My school coach also ran the team in Malta, so then I joined a boys' team pretty soon afterwards. I started school in Malta, then we moved to England. ‘When I came over here, I joined another boys’ team, and I played with them for a while, too,' adds Lola. 'I joined the Academy at Under-12 level, but I was only 10. I was playing against Chelsea with my boys’ team, and that's where they picked me up. Playing on a boys' team is always hard, but I also think it helped me to grow. I enjoyed the challenge.’ They say it takes a village to raise a child, and it’s certainly the same when it comes to developing a young footballer into a professional. Brown credits Leanne Champ at the Chelsea Academy and is also grateful to her family for the sacrifices they made when she was growing up as a young footballer. ‘Leanne helped me throughout the whole Academy,’ Brown continues. ‘She helped me progress as a player and developed my confidence. ‘It was all worth it when I signed my first professional contract two years ago. It was massive. I think that's when you realise it's more than just football. So many people have sacrificed so much for you to get to that moment. ‘My mum massively helped me to get where I am today. She would drive me literally every day. I lived far away, so it'd be like a four-hour round trip every single day. Mum did the driving, but even my siblings were at home making dinner for themselves so I could live my dream. It means so much. Still only 18, Brown can remember looking up to Chelsea players past and present. One of those heroes – Lucy Bronze – is now her Blues team-mate, a dream scenario for the enthusiastic young player. She recalls watching Bronze score the winner for Manchester City in the 2016 Women’s League Cup final. Brown even walked out alongside Willian as a mascot at Stamford Bridge before making her debut on the same pitch a few years later, with a few wise words in her ear from head coach Sonia Bompastor. ‘My two heroes were Bronze and Fran Kirby when I was growing up,’ she says. ‘A match that always comes into mind was my first ever women's match I went to, and I saw Lucy Bronze score a header in a final. I was a pretty big fan. Now I’m playing with her, which is a bit surreal. I felt a bit like that with Fran Kirby as well because she was here for a bit when I trained with her, and I’d always idolised her. ‘My debut against Celtic in the Champions League was so surreal, especially because it was at Stamford Bridge. I remember warming up and looking at the pitch, because it was the first time I'd been on it except for when I was really young as a mascot. I walked out with Willian on that day. ‘Even when I was warming up, I was thinking, "Oh, I could actually come on here at Stamford Bridge." So when I got subbed on, I was just super excited. The nerves disappeared, and it was more just excitement to get on the pitch. ‘I think Sonia said to enjoy it and take in the moment and to be brave and confident on the pitch.’ Wise words indeed for a player who has her whole future ahead of her and is here to stay at Chelsea.
news.body_zh: 当你与切尔西学院毕业生 Lola Brown 交谈时，很难相信她还只有 18 岁。她说话的成熟度远远超出了她的年龄，但她的眼中仍然闪烁着青春的光芒。很明显，她很饥饿，而且头脑冷静，她处于理想的位置，可以从切尔西的高级专业人士那里学到她需要学习的一切。再加上她在球场上的天赋，意味着为布朗提供三年续约的理由是显而易见的。在2024/25赛季国内三冠王赛季中，她首次代表蓝军成年队亮相，上赛季租借到水晶宫后，她又回到了SW6，热爱生活。 “足球对我来说绝对意味着一切，”她微笑着说。 “当你早上醒来时，你就会有一些值得奋斗的目标。它总是给我一个目标，而且我也很有竞争力，所以它驱使我想要获胜。 “不过，这不仅仅是比赛日。这是日复一日的。每一天你都在追求某些东西。这就是为什么它意味着一切。”也许布朗成熟的观点的部分原因是在外国海岸度过的童年经历。她在马耳他开始了她的学校生活，直到八岁，她的父母才返回英国。两年后，这位年轻人在切尔西青训学院获得了一席之地。 “我的父母刚刚去了马耳他，有点像度假，”她解释道。 “他们去了两年，但最终呆了 14 年，因为他们非常喜欢这里。我出生在那里，然后在那里住到八岁。我实际上非常喜欢那里。马耳他是我的重要组成部分；这是我长大的地方。就我的早期阶段和造就现在的我而言，我非常感谢马耳他。 “我全家都热爱运动。当我年轻的时候，我们都非常有竞争力和动力，这极大地塑造了我的性格。早年我周围的人确实蕴含着我想要遵循的良好道德。 “我总是和我的兄弟在马耳他的花园里踢足球。他比我大六岁，但当我一对一击败他时，他就会接我！我会有点生气，因为我不确定这是规则的一部分……“四五岁的时候，我开始在学校踢足球。我的学校教练也在马耳他管理球队，所以很快我就加入了男子球队。我在马耳他开始上学，然后我们搬到了英国。 “当我来到这里时，我加入了另一个男孩队，我也和他们一起玩了一段时间，”洛拉补充道。 “我加入了 12 岁以下级别的青训学院，但当时我只有 10 岁。我当时正在和我的男孩队对阵切尔西，他们就是在那里挑选了我。在男子球队踢球总是很困难，但我也认为这帮助了我成长。我喜欢这个挑战。”他们说养育一个孩子需要整个村庄的努力，而将一名年轻足球运动员培养成职业球员当然也是如此。布朗赞扬了切尔西青训学院的莉安·钱普，也感谢她的家人在她作为一名年轻足球运动员成长过程中所做出的牺牲。 “莉安在整个学院帮助了我，”布朗继续说道。 “她帮助我作为一名球员取得进步并增强了我的信心。 “两年前，当我签下第一份职业合同时，一切都是值得的。它是巨大的。我想那时你就会意识到这不仅仅是足球。为了你到达那一刻，很多人牺牲了很多。 “我的妈妈为我提供了巨大的帮助，让我取得了今天的成就。她几乎每天都会开车送我。我住的地方比较远，每天来回都要四个小时。妈妈负责开车，但就连我的兄弟姐妹也在家里为自己做饭，这样我就可以实现我的梦想。这意味着很多。年仅 18 岁的布朗还记得他对过去和现在的切尔西球员的仰慕之情。其中一位英雄——露西·青铜——现在是她的蓝军队友，这对这位热情的年轻球员来说是一个梦想的场景。她回忆起在 2016 年女子联赛杯决赛中观看铜牌为曼城攻入致胜球的情景。布朗甚至作为吉祥物与威廉一起走出斯坦福桥，几年后，她在同一球场上首次亮相，主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特在她耳边说了几句睿智的话。 “在我成长的过程中，我的两个英雄是布隆兹和弗兰·柯比，”她说。 “我脑海中总是浮现出一场比赛，这是我参加的第一场女子比赛，我看到露西·青铜在决赛中头球破门。我是一个非常大的粉丝。 现在我和她一起玩，这有点超现实。我对弗兰·柯比也有类似的感觉，因为当我和她一起训练时，她在这里待过一段时间，而且我一直很崇拜她。 “我在冠军联赛中对阵凯尔特人队的首秀是如此超现实，特别是因为那是在斯坦福桥。我记得热身时看着球场，因为这是我第一次踏上球场，除了我很小的时候作为吉祥物的时候。那天我和威廉一起出去了。 “即使在我热身的时候，我也在想，‘哦，我实际上可以来到斯坦福桥。’”所以当我被替换时，我非常兴奋。紧张感消失了，更多的是上场的兴奋。 “我认为索尼娅说过要享受这一切，把握当下，在球场上要勇敢和自信。”对于一个拥有整个未来并留在切尔西的球员来说，这句话确实明智。

news.title: Lola Brown signs new contract
news.title_zh: 洛拉·布朗签署新合同
news.body_en: Chelsea midfielder Lola Brown has put pen to paper on a new contract, committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Having joined the Blues during the 2019/20 season, she agreed her first professional contract in November 2024, aged 17. On signing her new deal, Brown said: ‘It feels amazing. I’m super proud. It’s a club I always wanted to sign a professional contract with, so to sign my second one is an amazing feeling. ‘Chelsea have developed me from a young age, and I can see how much I have developed here and how much I continue to develop. ‘Being around this environment and learning from the best helps you progress as a player. Now I want to win as many trophies as possible, and on a personal level I want to score my first professional goal as a Chelsea player.’ Brown was named Chelsea Women’s Academy Under-18 Player of the Year for the 2023/24 campaign. The teenager made her senior debut for the club the following season, coming on against Celtic in the Women’s Champions League group stage. She earned further minutes in a win over Twente, and towards the end of that domestic Treble-winning campaign, made her WSL debut in a victory at Tottenham. A loan move was next on the agenda for Brown as she moved across London to join Crystal Palace in WSL2. An injury hampered her progress in the first half of the campaign, but she returned to action in January and played a key role in the Eagles’ promotion back to the top flight. Palace went into a key clash with Portsmouth knowing that a win would guarantee automatic promotion. With the scores level at half-time, Brown was brought on and provided three assists to help secure an eventual 6-1 victory. She was voted the Player of the Match for her efforts. On the international stage, Brown has represented England at Under-16, Under-17, Under-19 and Under-20 levels, and has been called up to the Young Lionesses squad for September's U-20 Women's World Cup.
news.body_zh: 切尔西中场球员洛拉·布朗已经签署了一份新合同，将她的未来承诺到俱乐部至少到 2029 年。在 2019/20 赛季加入蓝军后，17 岁的她于 2024 年 11 月签订了第一份职业合同。在签署新合同时，布朗表示：“感觉棒极了。”我非常自豪。这是我一直想与之签订职业合同的俱乐部，所以签下我的第二份合同是一种奇妙的感觉。 “切尔西从小就培养了我，我可以看到我在这里发展了多少，并且还在继续发展。 “在这样的环境中并向最好的球员学习可以帮助你作为一名球员取得进步。现在我想赢得尽可能多的奖杯，在个人层面上，我想打进作为切尔西球员的第一个职业进球。”布朗被评为 2023/24 赛季切尔西女子学院 18 岁以下球员年度最佳球员。这名少年在接下来的赛季中首次代表俱乐部成年队亮相，在女子冠军联赛小组赛对阵凯尔特人队的比赛中登场。她在战胜特温特的比赛中赢得了更多的上场时间，并在国内三冠王赛季结束时在托特纳姆热刺队的胜利中完成了她的 WSL 处子秀。布朗的下一个议程是租借，因为她穿过伦敦加盟 WSL2 的水晶宫。上半程的伤病阻碍了她的进步，但她在一月份重返赛场，并在老鹰队重返顶级联赛的过程中发挥了关键作用。水晶宫在与朴茨茅斯的一场关键比赛中知道，一场胜利将确保自动晋级。半场战罢，布朗上场并送出3次助攻，帮助球队最终以6-1获胜。由于她的努力，她被评为本场最佳球员。在国际舞台上，布朗曾代表英格兰参加U-16、U-17、U-19和U-20级别的比赛，并被征召入青年狮队参加9月的U-20女子世界杯。

news.title: Fan Engagement Plan published for 2026/27 season
news.title_zh: 2026/27 赛季球迷参与计划公布
news.body_en: Today, we are delighted to launch the latest edition of our Fan Engagement Plan for the 2026/27 season. As part of the Premier League’s Fan Engagement Standard, the plan highlights the work achieved last season in engaging with our supporters and the vision for the season ahead to ensure regular dialogue with our fans. The plan is a requirement for all Premier League clubs, designed to provide clear outcomes and objectives for our strategic vision to engage with supporters. It highlights the events and campaigns organised with various supporter groups including the Chelsea Supporters’ Trust, Chelsea Pride, Chelsea Muslim Supporters Group and the Chelsea Jewish Supporters Group. As well as this, the plan sets out the key role of the Fan Advisory Board in ensuring that supporters engage with the club on long-term strategic initiatives that impact fan sentiment. Head of supporter relations Michael Cornall said, ‘We are delighted to publish our Fan Engagement Plan for the 2026/27 season. ‘We want fans to be able to engage at all levels of the club and welcome their views and input. We will continue to facilitate dialogue via multiple channels and forums as set out in the Fan Engagement Plan.’ Click to view the 2026/27 Fan Engagement Plan
news.body_zh: 今天，我们很高兴推出最新版 2026/27 赛季球迷参与计划。作为英超联赛球迷参与标准的一部分，该计划强调了上赛季在与球迷互动方面所取得的工作以及对未来赛季的愿景，以确保与球迷进行定期对话。该计划是所有英超俱乐部的要求，旨在为我们与支持者互动的战略愿景提供明确的成果和目标。它重点介绍了与各种支持者团体组织的活动和活动，包括切尔西支持者信托、切尔西骄傲、切尔西穆斯林支持者团体和切尔西犹太支持者团体。除此之外，该计划还规定了球迷咨询委员会的关键作用，以确保球迷与俱乐部就影响球迷情绪的长期战略举措进行互动。球迷关系主管迈克尔·康纳尔 (Michael Cornall) 表示：“我们很高兴发布 2026/27 赛季的球迷参与计划。 “我们希望球迷能够参与俱乐部各个层面的活动，并欢迎他们的观点和意见。我们将继续按照粉丝参与计划中的规定，通过多种渠道和论坛促进对话。点击查看 2026/27 粉丝参与计划

news.title: Chelsea Diary: The week we've all been waiting for
news.title_zh: 切尔西日记：我们一直在等待的一周
news.body_en: The 2026/27 campaign begins in earnest for our two senior teams this week, with Chelsea men's team facing three fixtures in the space of seven days and Sonia Bompastor's side getting underway in Europe. Xabi Alonso's Chelsea will play our first match of the Premier League campaign, while the Blues will hope a Carabao Cup run also starts this week. It is a Women's Champions League qualifying clash for Bompastor's team, and there are four matches across the Cobham Next Gen, Women's Under-21s and men's Under-18s this week. Add in a couple of notable anniversaries from the club's recent history, and there is plenty for Blues supporters to look forward to over the next seven days. The new Premier League season begins for Chelsea this evening with a short trip across west London to face Fulham at Craven Cottage. The Blues kick off the 2026/27 league campaign away from home, with the fixture selected as the opening Monday Night Football match of the season on Sky Sports. As always, supporters can follow all the action live in our Fulham vs Chelsea Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, where you'll find minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary. Fans can also experience the matchday through the new Chelsea Official App, where we will have an ongoing story from Craven Cottage, and we will of course bring you the latest team news, match report and reaction from just down the road. Today also marks the anniversary of Cesar Azpilicueta joining Chelsea in 2012. The Spaniard went on to become one of the most decorated captains in the club's history, lifting the Champions League, Europa League, Premier League, FA Cup and Club World Cup during an outstanding spell in blue. You can learn more about the bona-fida Blues legend here. After hearing from Alonso and his players after the Fulham match, attention quickly turns to the next challenge, with the men's team's preparations beginning for Thursday night's Carabao Cup second-round tie against Luton Town at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea enter the competition in round two and we will bring you the latest from Cobham ahead of that one. There is competitive action for our Cobham Next Gen side as they travel to Bristol Rovers in the EFL Cup for a 7pm kick-off. The young Blues will be looking to continue their development against senior opposition, with the competition providing another valuable opportunity for players on their pathway from Academy football towards the first team. Supporters can follow events with minute-by-minute updates in our Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, while those in the UK can watch the match on Sky Sports+. Blues supporters can also look forward to hearing from Chelsea Women head coach Bompastor ahead of our Champions League qualifying round first-leg tie at Stamford Bridge. You can watch the head coach's press conference live on the Chelsea Official App and website from 3pm. It's a European matchday for the Blues! The first leg sees us host Real Sociedad at Cherry Red Records Stadium, the home of AFC Wimbledon. Tickets are still available and can be purchased here from just £6 for under-16s and £12 for adults. For those further afield who can't make it to the ground, we will bring you the action as it happens via our Chelsea Women vs Real Sociedad Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website. The fixture represents the first competitive match of the new season for Bompastor's side as they seek to secure a place in the competition proper. Academy football is also on the agenda as Chelsea Under-18s travel to Wolverhampton Wanderers in the Premier League Cup at 2pm. Watch the match live with a CFC+ subscription on the Chelsea Official App and website. The men's team are back in action just three days after our league opener as Luton Town visit Stamford Bridge in the Carabao Cup. Cup competitions have delivered many memorable moments throughout Chelsea's history and the Blues will be looking to begin another campaign in the competition with a victory. Progression into the next round will be the objective as competitive football returns to the Bridge for the first time this season. Supporters can follow all the build-up, match coverage and post-match reaction across the club's official channels. Live audio commentary and minute-by-minute updates will be available in the Chelsea vs Luton Town Match Centre. Focus turns to Sunday's Premier League clash with Brighton & Hove Albion at Stamford Bridge. Alonso will address the media ahead of the match, with supporters able to hear from the manager on the Chelsea Official App and website. Friday also marks the anniversary of Willian joining Chelsea in 2013. The Brazilian quickly became a fan favourite during seven years at the club, winning two Premier League titles, the Europa League, FA Cup and League Cup while making more than 300 appearances in blue. There is more Academy action to enjoy this weekend, with Chelsea Under-18s back in U18 Premier League action at home to Reading at 11am. As with all eligible Academy fixtures, it will be available to watch live on the Chelsea Official App and website with a CFC+ subscription. Fans can find out more about CFC+ and available packages via our subscriptions page. We will also hear from Alonso and the Blues players as they put the finishing touches to preparations for the visit of Brighton. A busy week concludes as Premier League football returns to the Bridge, with Chelsea hosting a Brighton & Hove Albion side who beat Aston Villa 4-0 on Sunday. Hospitality tickets are still available here, and supporters can follow all the action live in our Chelsea vs Brighton Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, where you'll find minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary. Fans can also experience the matchday through the new Chelsea Official App, where we will have an ongoing story from the Bridge. Chelsea Women Under-21s are also back in action. They started the season with an 8-0 win over London City Lionesses and on Sunday welcome Crystal Palace Under-21s.

news.title: Cesar Azpilicueta: The Chelsea player who won it all
news.title_zh: 塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔：赢得一切的切尔西球员
news.body_en: On the anniversary of Chelsea legend Cesar Azpilicueta joining the club, we reflect on the Spaniard's 11 trophy-laden years as a Blues player. Azpilicueta recently announced he was hanging up his boots at the end of a long and distinguished career, which included more than a decade with Chelsea. Throughout his time at Stamford Bridge, Azpilicueta stepped up to whatever challenge was put in front of him. No matter the position, the formation or the head coach, the Spaniard was always an integral part of the team. When Azpilicueta first arrived ahead on August 24 2012, the then 23-year-old faced a tough task breaking into the side with Ashley Cole and Branislav Ivanovic well-established in the full-back roles and Chelsea champions of Europe after that famous night in Munich. However, Azpilicueta went from strength to strength over the course of the campaign after making his debut in a 6-0 home win over Wolverhampton Wanderers in the League Cup. He became an almost ever-present at right-back in the latter months of the season and played the full 90 minutes in all but one of our UEFA Europa League games en route to glory in Amsterdam. Ivanovic was Jose Mourinho’s preferred option on the right of defence early into the campaign that followed, although Azpilicueta’s first start of 2013/14 – a 2-0 League Cup win at Arsenal – did bring his first goal for the club. Cesar’s versatility was soon demonstrated, however, following an injury to Cole. After a fine performance at left-back against Schalke in the UEFA Champions League, he made the spot his own, a situation which did not change even after Cole returned to fitness. Azpilicueta had forced his way into his manager’s plans and contributed immensely to the Premier League’s best defensive record – we conceded just 27 times in 38 games. As a result, Azpilicueta was named our Players’ Player of the Year. He remained the first choice left-back despite the signing of Filipe Luis ahead of the 2014/15 season. Once again, Azpilicueta was a vital member of the team as the first league title of his career was sealed. He made 29 top-flight appearances as well as helping us keep a clean sheet in a League Cup final win over Tottenham Hotspur. The defender’s first Premier League goal for Chelsea earned a 3-2 win over West Bromwich Albion early in the next season, before he reverted to his natural position on the right of our backline under Guus Hiddink in 2015/16. Another change of role followed as Azpilicueta was used on the right of Antonio Conte’s three-man defence, which he implemented early into his tenure at Stamford Bridge. Azpilicueta excelled as an impressive run of clean sheets contributed to a club-record sequence of wins. He would go on to play in every minute of every league game in our title-winning 2016/17 season, only the fourth outfield player ever to do so for a victorious Premier League side. And it was his assist for Michy Batshuayi’s goal at West Brom which ultimately secured that status for Chelsea. Azpilicueta’s leadership qualities were also coming to the fore. He captained Chelsea on 21 occasions in 2017/18, in addition to enjoying his best campaign to that point from an attacking point of view. He scored three goals and set up plenty more, particularly through his excellent understanding with Alvaro Morata. But it was his defensive prowess on show in a clean sheet at Wembley as we beat Manchester United in the FA Cup final. Returning to right-back in Maurizio Sarri’s side, Azpilicueta made more appearances than any other Blues player for the third successive campaign, culminating in leading the team out in Baku for our 2019 Europa League final win over Arsenal. His only goal of the season, a late equaliser at Cardiff City, turned out to be a crucial one in the top-four race. His status as captain was made permanent following the departure of Gary Cahill in 2019 and Azpilicueta’s versatility would prove vital in his first campaign as full-time skipper, featuring in four different positions as Frank Lampard frequently shifted formations. His experience played a big part when football returned following a hiatus during the Covid-19 pandemic. Azpi played every minute for the remainder of the Premier League as we homed in on Champions League qualification, although his presence was missed when an injury forced him off with the scores tied 1-1 in our FA Cup final defeat to Arsenal. The emergence of Reece James meant Azpi’s opportunities were limited in the first half of 2020/21, even if his selfless attitude meant he was still an important figure, helping to guide a youthful squad full of potential but light on experience. However, he was straight into the starting line-up after the arrival of Thomas Tuchel and provided the first goal of our new head coach’s reign by scoring the opener in a 2-0 win against Burnley. A season which had started with the ever-resilient Azpilicueta on the fringes would end with arguably his greatest moment at Chelsea. Switching between playing on the right of a back three and at wing-back, he missed just three games in all competitions for Tuchel, leading by example in big games to produce some of his best performances for the club. He became only the second Chelsea captain to lift the Champions League trophy after we beat Manchester City in the final in Porto, one late defensive block to preserve our clean sheet epitomising his commitment to the cause. His contribution was recognised as one of four Blues named on the 30-man shortlist for the 2021 Ballon d’Or. Azpilicueta’s penultimate season at Stamford Bridge underlined his status as one the most successful Chelsea players of all time, as he captained us to two more trophies in the form of the UEFA Super Cup and, for the first time in our history, the FIFA Club World Cup. He completed his own clean sweep of major silverware in the process. Those trophy successes were followed by a major landmark as Azpi captained the side for the 200th time, in a 1-1 Premier League draw with Manchester United in April, five years after he had first worn the armband, at Wembley in a 4-2 FA Cup semi-final win over Tottenham. Azpilicueta passed the 500-game mark in his last season at Chelsea. He left the club having made more appearances than any other overseas player in our history. Indeed, only five Blues have featured more for Chelsea, and he rightly joins Ron Harris, Peter Bonetti, John Terry, Frank Lampard and John Hollins on the list of true club legends. Departed, retired, but never forgotten. The Chelsea player who really did win it all.
news.body_zh: 在切尔西传奇人物塞萨尔·阿兹皮利奎塔加入俱乐部周年纪念日之际，我们回顾了西班牙人作为蓝军球员的 11 个充满奖杯的岁月。阿斯皮利奎塔最近宣布，他在漫长而杰出的职业生涯（其中包括在切尔西效力十多年）即将结束，将挂靴。在斯坦福桥效力期间，阿斯皮利奎塔勇敢地面对摆在他面前的任何挑战。无论位置、阵型还是主教练，西班牙人始终是球队不可或缺的一部分。当阿斯皮利奎塔于2012年8月24日首次取得领先时，这位当时23岁的球员面临着一项艰巨的任务，他要突破阿什利·科尔和布拉尼斯拉夫·伊万诺维奇的边后卫位置，并在慕尼黑那个著名的夜晚后帮助切尔西夺得欧洲冠军。然而，阿斯皮利奎塔在联赛杯主场6-0战胜狼队的比赛中首次亮相后，整个赛季的实力不断增强。在赛季的后几个月里，他几乎成为了右后卫的常客，并在除一场欧洲联赛之外的所有比赛中打满了 90 分钟，最终在阿姆斯特丹赢得了荣耀。在随后的赛季初期，伊万诺维奇是穆里尼奥在右后卫的首选，尽管阿斯皮利奎塔在2013/14赛季的首次首发——2-0战胜阿森纳的联赛杯——确实为俱乐部带来了他的第一个进球。然而，在科尔受伤后，塞萨尔的多才多艺很快就得到了证明。在欧冠对阵沙尔克的左后卫中表现出色后，他占据了自己的位置，即使科尔恢复健康后，这种情况也没有改变。阿斯皮利奎塔强行进入了主教练的计划，并为英超联赛的最佳防守记录做出了巨大贡献——我们在 38 场比赛中只丢了 27 个球。结果，阿斯皮利奎塔被评为我们的年度最佳球员。尽管在2014/15赛季之前签下了菲利佩·路易斯，但他仍然是左后卫的首选。阿斯皮利奎塔再次成为球队的重要成员，赢得了他职业生涯的第一个联赛冠军。他在顶级联赛中出场 29 次，并帮助我们在联赛杯决赛战胜托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中保持不失球。这位后卫在下个赛季初期为切尔西打入首个英超联赛进球，帮助球队以 3-2 战胜西布罗姆维奇，随后他在 2015/16 赛季在希丁克的带领下回到了我们后防线右侧的自然位置。随后角色又发生了变化，阿斯皮利奎塔被安排在安东尼奥·孔蒂的三人防守的右侧，这是他在斯坦福桥任职初期实施的。阿斯皮利奎塔表现出色，连续几场不失球，创造了俱乐部连胜纪录。在我们夺冠的 2016/17 赛季中，他在每场联赛的每场比赛中都打满了比赛，这是英超联赛获胜球队中第四位做到这一点的外场球员。正是他在西布朗队帮助米奇·巴舒亚伊进球，最终为切尔西确保了这一地位。阿斯皮利奎塔的领导才能也逐渐凸显。 2017/18赛季，他21次担任切尔西队长，此外，从进攻角度来看，他也享受了迄今为止最好的赛季。他打进了三个进球，并创造了更多进球，尤其是通过他与阿尔瓦罗·莫拉塔的出色默契。但当我们在足总杯决赛中击败曼联时，他在温布利保持零失球的表现展现了他的防守能力。重返毛里齐奥·萨里麾下的右后卫位置后，阿斯皮利奎塔连续第三个赛季出场次数超过任何其他蓝军球员，并最终带领球队在巴库赢得了 2019 年欧罗巴联赛决赛战胜阿森纳的比赛。他本赛季唯一的进球是在卡迪夫城最后时刻扳平比分的进球，这对前四名的争夺至关重要。 2019年加里·卡希尔离开后，他的队长地位被永久保留，阿斯皮利奎塔的多才多艺在他作为全职队长的第一个赛季中证明是至关重要的，在弗兰克·兰帕德频繁变换阵型的情况下，他在四个不同的位置上出战。当足球运动在 Covid-19 大流行期间中断后重新回归时，他的经历发挥了重要作用。阿斯皮在英超剩下的比赛中打满了每一分钟，我们最终锁定了欧冠资格，但在我们足总杯决赛1-1输给阿森纳的比赛中，他因伤缺席，缺席了比赛。 里斯·詹姆斯的出现意味着阿斯皮在2020/21赛季上半段的机会有限，尽管他无私的态度意味着他仍然是一个重要人物，帮助指导一支充满潜力但缺乏经验的年轻球队。然而，在托马斯·图赫尔到来后，他直接进入了首发阵容，并在我们新任主教练执教期间的首个进球，帮助球队2-0战胜伯恩利。一个以永远坚韧的阿斯皮利奎塔处于边缘的赛季开始的赛季，可以说是他在切尔西最伟大的时刻。在三后卫的右侧和边后卫之间转换时，他在图赫尔的所有比赛中只缺席了三场比赛，在重大比赛中以身作则，为俱乐部创造了一些最好的表现。在我们在波尔图的决赛中击败曼城之后，他成为第二位举起冠军联赛奖杯的切尔西队长，最后时刻的防守阻止我们保住了不失球，这体现了他对这一事业的承诺。他的贡献被公认为 2021 年金球奖 30 人候选名单中的四名蓝军之一。阿斯皮利奎塔在斯坦福桥的倒数第二个赛季突显了他作为切尔西有史以来最成功球员之一的地位，他带领我们赢得了另外两座奖杯：欧洲超级杯，以及我们历史上第一次的国际足联俱乐部世界杯。在此过程中，他完成了自己对主要奖杯的横扫。在这些奖杯的成功之后，阿斯皮迎来了一个重要的里程碑，他在 4 月份英超联赛 1-1 战平曼联的比赛中第 200 次担任球队队长，五年前，他第一次戴上队长袖标，在温布利 4-2 战胜托特纳姆热刺的足总杯半决赛中。阿斯皮利奎塔在切尔西的最后一个赛季出场次数突破了 500 场大关。他离开俱乐部的次数比我们历史上任何其他海外球员都多。事实上，只有五名蓝军球员为切尔西做出了更多贡献，他理所当然地与罗恩·哈里斯、彼得·博内蒂、约翰·特里、弗兰克·兰帕德和约翰·霍林斯一起跻身真正的俱乐部传奇人物之列。离开了，退休了，但从未被遗忘。这位真正赢得了一切的切尔西球员。

news.title: Fulham vs Chelsea: All you need to know
news.title_zh: 富勒姆 vs 切尔西：你需要知道的一切
news.body_en: A west London derby kicks off Chelsea’s league campaign for the first time in our history with the short trip down the river for Monday’s 8pm fixture at Fulham. This will be the fourth time the Blues’ season opens on the first day of the week – we won each of the previous three at Burnley (2014/15), home to West Ham (2016/17) and away to Brighton (2020/21). Two of those became title-winning seasons and the other ended in Champions League glory. Overall, Chelsea have won eleven of the past 14 Premier League matches played on a Monday. The World champions have also taken three points from four of the past five all-capital clashes in the top flight. Chelsea’s new manager Xabi Alonso and his Cottagers counterpart Alvaro Arbeloa have much in common. They both managed Real Madrid in 2025/26 and were Liverpool team-mates in nine historic games against the Blues, losing four and drawing three. This is the first time any manager’s Premier League bow has come against a former team-mate in that competition. The Blues’ 2-1 loss on the bank of the Thames was one of many affected by red cards last season – Marc Cucurella receiving his marching orders for denying a goalscoring opportunity after just 22 minutes. One legacy of that unhappy collection of red and yellow cards is that Wes Fofana is suspended for our opening two fixtures. 22 Man United20 Chelsea = Arsenal17 Man City16 Liverpool Chelsea have started the Premier League season with a London derby five times without defeat. A highlight of the 4-2 home win against West Ham in 2000 was a spectacular debut goal from distance by Mario Stanic, while the 3-2 at Charlton is remembered as much for red-carded Paul Konchesky’s elbow as the visitors’ Gianfranco Zola-inspired comeback and Frank Lampard’s coup de grace. The Hammers were beaten again in 2016, ushering in what would be a title-winning season under Antonio Conte. This time it was Diego Costa’s turn to settle the outcome in a 2-1 win. In 2021 Crystal Palace were the victims of a 3-0 pounding at the Bridge, Trevoh Chalobah among the goalscorers with his first for the Blues. When the same opponents rolled up in west London as FA Cup and Community Shield-winners last season, the run of wins in derby openers ended with an uneventful goalless draw. So far, all-capital clashes have accounted for 14 starts to a Chelsea league campaign. Back in 1957 at White Hart Lane, 17-year-old Jimmy Greaves made an auspicious scoring debut against Tottenham. In 1984, the Blues’ long-awaited return to the top tier was marked with an opener at Arsenal and John Neal’s newly-promoted side shared the spoils thanks to Kerry Dixon’s volleyed equaliser. - This is Chelsea's 35th campaign in the Premier League, and we are one of just six ever-present clubs in the competition. - Twenty-seven Chelsea players have scored a Premier League debut goal, most recently Christopher Nkunku at Wolves in December 2023. - The Blues have failed to win the opening Premier League game in each of the past three seasons (two draws, one loss). - However, the World champions have won six of the last eight league meetings at Craven Cottage, Fulham two. - Alonso’s first fixture outside London will be at Everton on 17 October – we will play at least seven matches across the capital before then. - Ten years ago Chelsea finished tenth in the Premier League with no European qualification but went on to win the title the following season, 2016/17. - Three Blues managers (Jose Mourinho, Carlo Ancelotti and Conte) have won the Premier League title during their debut season in charge – more than any other club. - The transfer window will close on Tuesday 1 September at 11pm UK time. - The building of the River Thames embankment near Craven Cottage stadium was carried out by contractors working for the Mears family out of Crabtree Wharf. The Mears family were later founding members of Chelsea FC.
news.body_zh: 一场西伦敦德比拉开了切尔西历史上第一次联赛的序幕，周一晚上 8 点对阵富勒姆的比赛将在河中进行短暂的旅程。这将是蓝军第四次在本周的第一天开始赛季——我们在伯恩利（2014/15赛季）、主场对阵西汉姆联（2016/17赛季）以及客场对阵布莱顿（2020/21赛季）的比赛中均获胜。其中两个赛季赢得了冠军，另一个赛季则获得了冠军联赛的荣耀。总体而言，过去 14 场周一进行的英超比赛中，切尔西赢了 11 场。世界冠军在过去五场顶级联赛的全首都比赛中，四场比赛中都拿到了三分。切尔西的新任主教练哈维·阿隆索和他的乡村队主教练阿尔瓦罗·阿贝洛亚有很多共同点。他们在2025/26赛季都曾执教皇家马德里，并在对阵蓝军的九场历史性比赛中作为利物浦队友，取得了四胜三平的成绩。这是英超联赛中第一次有主帅向前队友鞠躬。蓝军在泰晤士河畔2-1失利是上赛季众多受红牌影响的比赛之一——马克·库库雷拉(Marc Cucurella)在开场仅22分钟就因拒绝进球机会而被罚下场。令人不快的红牌和黄牌带来的后果之一是韦斯·福法纳在我们的前两场比赛中被禁赛。 22 曼联 20 切尔西 = 阿森纳 17 曼城 16 利物浦 切尔西以伦敦德比五次不败开启英超新赛季。 2000年主场4-2战胜西汉姆联队的一大亮点是马里奥·斯坦尼奇的精彩首个远射进球，而查尔顿队3-2的比赛中，保罗·孔切斯基的红牌肘击、吉安弗兰科·佐拉的反击以及弗兰克·兰帕德的致命一击同样被人们铭记。 2016年，铁锤帮再次惨败，在安东尼奥·孔蒂的带领下迎来了夺冠赛季。这次轮到迭戈·科斯塔以2-1获胜。 2021 年，水晶宫在蓝桥遭遇了 3-0 的惨败，特雷沃·查洛巴 (Trevoh Chalobah) 是进球者之一，他为蓝军打进了第一个进球。上赛季，当同样的对手作为足总杯和社区盾杯冠军在伦敦西部相遇时，德比揭幕战的连胜却以一场平安无事的互交平局结束。到目前为止，切尔西联赛已经有 14 场比赛首发。 1957 年，17 岁的吉米·格里夫斯在白鹿巷球场对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中首次上演进球。 1984年，蓝军期待已久地重返顶级联赛，在对阵阿森纳的首场比赛中，约翰·尼尔的升班马凭借克里·迪克森的凌空抽射扳平比分，分享了战利品。 - 这是切尔西在英超联赛中第 35 次征战，我们是仅有的六支常年参加英超联赛的俱乐部之一。 - 有 27 名切尔西球员打进了英超首秀进球，最近一次是 2023 年 12 月克里斯托弗·恩昆库 (Christopher Nkunku) 在狼队的比赛中攻入的进球。 - 蓝军在过去三个赛季中都未能赢得英超首场比赛（两平一负）。 - 然而，世界冠军在过去八场在克雷文小屋举行的联赛中赢了六场，在富勒姆赢了两场。 - 阿隆索在伦敦以外的首场比赛将于 10 月 17 日在埃弗顿举行，在此之前我们将在伦敦至少进行七场比赛。 - 十年前，切尔西在英超联赛中排名第十，但没有获得欧洲资格，但在接下来的2016/17赛季赢得了冠军。 - 三名蓝军主教练（何塞·穆里尼奥、卡洛·安切洛蒂和孔蒂）在执教的第一个赛季就赢得了英超冠军——比任何其他俱乐部都多。 - 转会窗口将于英国时间 9 月 1 日星期二晚上 11 点关闭。 - Craven Cottage 体育场附近泰晤士河堤坝的建设是由克拉布特里码头外米尔斯家族的承包商建造的。米尔斯家族后来成为切尔西足球俱乐部的创始成员。

news.title: Summer transfers 2026: All the Chelsea ins, outs and new contracts so far
news.title_zh: 2026 年夏季转会：迄今为止切尔西的所有进场、出局和新合同
news.body_en: With the 2026 summer transfer window now open, we keep you updated with all the deals done so far this summer... Versatile midfielder Barco arrived from Strasbourg, signing a contract until 2033. He has previous experience of English football with Brighton. The 29-year-old Spaniard joined Chelsea early in August following four seasons with Rayo Vallecano. The experienced England international joined the Blues in August after leaving Brentford, agreeing a two-year deal at Stamford Bridge. Lacroix made the short journey from Crystal Palace to Chelsea towards the end of July, fresh from his involvement for France at the 2026 World Cup. Lacroix's deal lasts until 2032. The Italian international became our first signing of the summer when he joined on a permanent deal from Atalanta at the start of July. Palestra signed a contract through to 2033. The winger's move to Chelsea was first confirmed in March 2025, before officially completing his move from Sporting Lisbon this summer. The Portuguese teenager signed a contract until 2034. England international Morgan Rogers signed from Aston Villa in July 2026, penning a contract until 2033. He has played 22 times for the Three Lions, including at this summer's World Cup, and established himself as one of the top attacking talents in the Premier League. Dastan Satpayev completed a transfer to Chelsea after his 18th birthday, having been a part of our pre-season tour in Australia and Asia. He subsequently joined Burnley on loan. Joining from Brighton and Hove Albion, where he had impressed in recent seasons, striker Welbeck became our fifth signing of the summer. His contract runs to 2028. 18-year-old Bettoni joined from Wigan Athletic on a contract until 2030. The attacking midfielder featured 27 times for the Latics last season, scoring four goals. Osborne, 18, joined from Hearts in Scotland and put pen to paper on a contract with the Blues until 2030. Toby Bell signed his first professional contract. The goalkeeper made his Under-18 debut in November 2024 and has represented England throughout his development pathway. The young winger commited his long-term future to Chelsea by signing a new contract until 2032, shortly before agreeing a loan switch to swap London for Lisbon in the 2026/27 season with a spell at Sporting. Academy attacker Sol Gordon signed a new contract until 2029. Having joined Chelsea's development centre at Under-8 level, Gordon has progressed through the Academy ranks to become a regular for our Under-18s and has also featured for the Blues' Under-21s. Academy striker Jashayde Greenwood signed his first professional contract with the club following his 17th birthday and after a successful maiden campaign at Chelsea. Harrison, an Academy midfielder who established himself as a regular for our Under-21s last season as we lifted the Premier League 2 title, signed a new contract until 2029. He later joined Wimbledon on loan. Our midfielder signed his first professional contract with the Blues following his 17th birthday. He has been with our Academy since Under-8s level. Academy defender Osagie signed a new contract keeping him at the club until 2029. He established himself as an important member of our Under-21 side last season. Ahead of the campaign starting, Joao Pedro signed a new contract with Chelsea until 2034. The Brazilian netted 20 goals in his debut season at the Bridge and was voted our Player of the Year. Before joining Dulwich Hamlet on loan, Academy goalkeeper Sands signed a new three-year contract. After captaining Chelsea Under-18s to victory in the Under-18 Premier League national final in 2026, the centre-back signed his first professional contract with the Blues. The 19-year-old Academy player embarked on his first loan in August 2026, joining Ligue 1 side Strasbourg for the forthcoming campaign. The defender, who has played 71 times for the Blues, joined Napoli on loan for the season. The Argentina international joined Aston Villa on loan for 2026/27 having scored eight goals in 43 appearances in his first season at Stamford Bridge. Academy midfielder Harrison signed for League One side AFC Wimbledon for the season, embarking on his maiden loan away from the Bridge. The goalkeeper has moved to Strasbourg on loan for the season. The 17-year-old winger departed on his maiden loan spell in the senior game, signing for Portsmouth ahead of the Championship season starting. Young goalkeeper Max Merrick embarked on his third loan away from the Bridge by joining Hartlepool United of the National League for the season. He has been in our first team matchday squad on 11 occasions in recent years. Chelsea Academy defender Murray-Campbell, who made his senior Blues debut against Shamrock Rovers in the 2024/25 UEFA Conference League, will spend the coming season gaining further experience of men's football with KV Kortrijk in the Belgian first division. The defender has joined Notts County of League One for the 2026/27 campaign, following his loan spell with Swansea City last term. The young goalkeeper signed a new contract until 2029 and joined non-league side Dulwich Hamlet on a youth loan. After completing his transfer to Chelsea, the Kazakh attacker moved to Burnley on loan for the season. Walsh, who played four games for our senior team in 2025 including as a 16-year-old, will spend the season on loan at Wigan Athletic in League One this season. Wilson embarked on his first loan in senior football in July 2026, joining newly-promoted League Two side Rochdale for the forthcoming campaign. The winger left for Ipswich Town after a season playing for our Academy sides. Chalobah completed a permanent transfer to Como in August, bringing his time as a Chelsea player to an end after nearly two decades with the Blues. He won four trophies, having established himself in our first team ahead of the 2021/22 campaign. The Spaniard left for Real Madrid after four successful seasons at Stamford Bridge during which he won the Club World Cup and the UEFA Conference League, as well as helping Spain triumph in the 2024 Euros. The winger made his loan move to Everton permanent this summer, departing Chelsea after progressing through our Academy and making 37 appearances for the senior team. The versatile defender spent 13 years in our Academy having joined as an Under-8. He was released at the end of the 2025/26 season, which he spent on loan at AFC Wimbledon. The Academy forward completed a permanent move to Championship side West Bromwich Albion after impressing on loan at Peterborough last season. Morgan had returned to Chelsea, where he spent time in our Academy as a youngster, in February 2023. Olise also moved on after a decade with the club. Signed by Chelsea as an Under-9, Olise featured throughout the age groups in our Academy and was named in the first-team squad for our UEFA Conference League trip to Astana during the 2024/25 season. Runham sealed a permanent switch to Ipswich Town having spent the second half of last season on loan with the Tractor Boys. The move brought the attacking midfielder's long association with Chelsea to an end. Rak-Sakyi made four first-team appearances, all in our triumphant Conference League campaign, having developed through our Academy. The midfield was released at the expiry of his contract. The midfielder made 47 appearances for Chelsea and became a full Brazil international during his three years as a Blue. He has now completed a permanent transfer to Manchester United. The Finnish youth international's six-year spell at Chelsea ended this summer. He made his first-team debut in an FA Cup win over Leeds in March 2024, and also featured in the Premier League when he came on in a home victory against Tottenham. The young defender spent the second half of last season on loan at Brentford, featuring mainly for their reserve side, and made that switch permanent over the summer.
news.body_zh: 随着 2026 年夏季转会窗口现已开放，我们会及时向您通报今年夏天迄今为止完成的所有交易……多才多艺的中场球员巴科从斯特拉斯堡加盟，合同期至 2033 年。他之前曾在布莱顿效力过英格兰足球。这位 29 岁的西班牙人在拉约·巴列卡诺效力了四个赛季后于八月初加盟切尔西。这位经验丰富的英格兰国脚在离开布伦特福德后于八月加盟蓝军，并与斯坦福桥签订了一份为期两年的合同。拉克鲁瓦在 7 月底从水晶宫前往切尔西进行了短暂旅程，刚刚代表法国队参加了 2026 年世界杯。拉克鲁瓦的合同有效期至 2032 年。这位意大利国脚于 7 月初从亚特兰大永久签约，成为我们今年夏天的第一笔签约。帕莱斯特拉签订的合同到2033年为止。这位边锋于2025年3月首次确认转会至切尔西，然后在今年夏天正式完成从里斯本竞技的转会。这位葡萄牙少年的合同到2034年为止。英格兰国脚摩根·罗杰斯于2026年7月从阿斯顿维拉签约，合同到2033年为止。他已经为三狮军团出场22次，包括今年夏天的世界杯，并确立了自己作为英超顶级进攻天才之一的地位。达斯坦·萨帕耶夫 (Dastan Satpayev) 在 18 岁生日后完成转会至切尔西，参加了我们在澳大利亚和亚洲的季前赛之旅。随后他被租借加盟伯恩利。前锋维尔贝克从近几个赛季给人留下深刻印象的布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩加盟，成为我们今年夏天的第五名签约球员。他的合同有效期至2028年。18岁的贝托尼从维冈竞技加盟，合同期至2030年。这位攻击型中场上赛季为维冈竞技出场27次，打进4球。 18 岁的奥斯本从苏格兰红心队加盟，并与蓝军签订了一份至 2030 年的合同。托比·贝尔签署了他的第一份职业合同。这位门将于 2024 年 11 月首次代表 18 岁以下国家队出场，并在他的整个发展道路上代表英格兰队出场。这位年轻的边锋将自己的长期未来交给了切尔西，签下了一份到2032年的新合同，不久之后他同意租借转会，在2026/27赛季从伦敦转会到里斯本，并在里斯本竞技效力了一段时间。青训前锋索尔·戈登签署了一份新合同，直至 2029 年。在加入切尔西 8 岁以下级别的发展中心后，戈登已经在青训营中不断晋升，成为我们 18 岁以下青年队的主力球员，并且还为蓝军 21 岁以下青年队效力。青训前锋贾沙伊德·格林伍德在 17 岁生日后以及在切尔西取得成功的处女赛季后与俱乐部签订了第一份职业合同。哈里森是一名青训营中场球员，上赛季我们举起了英超二级联赛冠军，他成为了我们 21 岁以下青年队的主力球员，他签下了一份新合同至 2029 年。后来他租借加盟温布尔登。我们的中场球员在 17 岁生日后与蓝军签订了第一份职业合同。他从 8 岁以下级别开始就在我们学院工作。青训后卫奥萨吉签署了一份新合同，让他在俱乐部效力至 2029 年。上赛季他确立了自己作为我们 21 岁以下球队的重要成员的地位。在赛季开始前，若昂·佩德罗与切尔西签订了一份到 2034 年的新合同。这位巴西人在蓝桥的首个赛季就攻入了 20 个进球，并被评为我们的年度最佳球员。在租借加盟德威哈姆雷特之前，学院门将桑兹签订了一份为期三年的新合同。在带领切尔西 U-18 队在 2026 年 U-18 英超联赛全国决赛中获胜后，这位中后卫与蓝军签订了他的第一份职业合同。这位19岁的青训球员于2026年8月开始了他的第一次租借，加盟法甲球队斯特拉斯堡参加即将到来的赛季。这名后卫为蓝军出场71次，本赛季租借加盟那不勒斯。这位阿根廷国脚在2026/27赛季租借加盟阿斯顿维拉，他在斯坦福桥的第一个赛季出场43次打进8球。青训中场球员哈里森本赛季与甲级联赛球队亚足联温布尔登签约，开始了他在蓝桥的首次租借。这名门将本赛季被租借到斯特拉斯堡。这位17岁的边锋在成年队比赛中首次租借，在英冠赛季开始前加盟朴茨茅斯。 年轻门将马克斯·梅里克开始了他第三次租借离开蓝桥，加盟国家联赛的哈特尔普尔联队本赛季。近年来，他曾 11 次入选我们一线队的比赛阵容。切尔西学院后卫穆雷-坎贝尔在 2024/25 赛季欧洲足联会议联赛中对阵沙姆洛克流浪者队的比赛中完成了他的蓝军首秀，他将在下个赛季与比利时甲级联赛的 KV Kortrijk 一起获得更多的男子足球经验。这名后卫上赛季被租借到斯旺西城，随后加盟了英甲联赛的诺茨郡队参加2026/27赛季的比赛。这位年轻门将续约至2029年，并以青年租借的方式加盟非联赛球队德威哈姆雷特。在完成转会至切尔西后，这位哈萨克斯坦前锋被租借至伯恩利一个赛季。沃尔什在 2025 年为我们的成年队踢了四场比赛，其中包括 16 岁时的比赛，本赛季他将被租借到英甲联赛的维冈竞技队度过整个赛季。威尔逊于 2026 年 7 月开始了他在成年足球队的第一次租借，加盟新晋级的乙级联赛球队罗奇代尔参加即将到来的赛季。这位边锋在为我们的青训队效力一个赛季后离开前往伊普斯维奇镇。查洛巴于八月永久转会至科莫，结束了他在蓝军效力近二十年后的切尔西球员生涯。他赢得了四座奖杯，在 2021/22 赛季之前确立了自己在我们一线队的地位。这位西班牙人在斯坦福桥度过了四个成功的赛季后前往皇家马德里，期间他赢得了世俱杯和欧洲联盟联赛冠军，并帮助西班牙赢得了 2024 年欧洲杯。这位边锋于今年夏天永久租借至埃弗顿，在完成青训并为成年队出场 37 次后离开切尔西。这位多才多艺的后卫在我们的青训营度过了 13 年，作为 8 岁以下球员加入。他在2025/26赛季结束后被释放，并被租借到亚足联温布尔登。这位青训前锋上赛季租借到彼得伯勒队给人留下了深刻的印象，之后永久转会至英冠球队西布罗姆维奇队。 2023 年 2 月，摩根回到了切尔西，年轻时他曾在我们的青训营度过了一段时光。奥利斯在俱乐部效力十年后也离开了球队。奥利塞作为 9 岁以下球员被切尔西签下，在我们青训营的各个年龄段中都有出色表现，并入选了 2024/25 赛季前往阿斯塔纳的欧足联会议联赛的一线队阵容。鲁纳姆在上赛季后半段被租借到拖拉机男孩队后，永久转会到伊普斯维奇镇。此举结束了这位攻击型中场与切尔西的长期合作关系。拉克-萨基在我们青训学院的培养下，在我们凯旋的分区联赛中四次代表一线队出场。这名中场球员在合同到期后被释放。这位中场球员为切尔西出场 47 次，并在效力蓝军的三年里成为一名正式的巴西国脚。他现在已经完成了向曼联的永久转会。这位芬兰青年国脚在切尔西的六年任期于今年夏天结束。 2024年3月，他在足总杯战胜利兹联的比赛中完成一线队首秀，并在主场战胜托特纳姆热刺的英超联赛中出场。这位年轻的后卫上赛季后半段被租借到布伦特福德，主要为预备队效力，并在夏天永久转会。

news.title: Ticket forwarding open for Luton and Brighton matches
news.title_zh: 卢顿和布莱顿比赛门票转发开放
news.body_en: We can confirm to supporters that ticket forwarding is now open for the two matches at Stamford Bridge in the coming week. news.title: Inside the life of Veerle Buurman
news.title_zh: 维尔勒·布尔曼 (Veerle Buurman) 的生活经历
news.body_en: This season, we will be catching up with Chelsea players to give you even more insight into some of your favourite stars. The next to sit down with us is talented defender Veerle Buurman... Where did you grow up, and what was it like there? I grew up in a place called Bemmel. It was a really nice village. I grew up with my younger brother and older brother, and my parents. It was a really good life there. What age did you first start playing football? I started playing when I was five years old. What was the name of your first grassroots team? It wasn't really a formal team at first. I started playing with two of my best friends and we trained every Wednesday. Eventually, it called F15. How old were you when you first joined an academy? I played for 12 years with the boys at my village club, SC Bemmel. Then I joined the youth team at PSV and was there for about six months before moving into the first team. Who would you say has been the biggest influence on your football career to date? What's your biggest career highlight to date? Playing for the national team, being at Chelsea, my time at PSV and, of course, my early days at Bemmel. So everything really! Who are your best friends in football? I have quite a lot of friends. At Chelsea, I'm really close with Liv, Sio and Mika. Outside of Chelsea, I have friends from PSV like Lisan [Alkemade], Emma [Frijns] and Moon [Pondes]. Can you name your top three favourite players of all time? Virgil van Dijk is my idol because of his playing style as a centre-back. And, of course, Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo are incredible players who have inspired me. In England, they call me Vee. In Dutch, it's Veer or Veertje, which is an affectionate version of my name. What do you like to do most away from football? I love spending time with good people and doing nice things. Outside of football, things that you always want to do but sometimes when you are within football you can't. And also being with my family and friends. Are you watching any TV series at the moment you could recommend? If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who would be dominating your most-played artists? I listen to a mix of everything, but Olivia Dean is definitely one of my favourites. What are your top three holiday destinations? In Europe I really like Spain and Italy. I really want to visit Greece as well and also Portugal which I would really like to surf one day. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them? I'd probably make some nice wraps and tacos. What's the best piece of advice you've ever received? From my parents, it's to keep both feet on the ground and believe in yourself. What does football mean to you? Everything. I love football. I have a lot of fun both on and off the pitch. Laughing and enjoying the game is the most important thing for me.
news.body_zh: 本赛季，我们将采访切尔西球员，让您更深入地了解一些您最喜欢的球星。下一个和我们一起坐下来的是才华横溢的后卫维尔勒·布尔曼（Veerle Buurman）……你在哪里长大，那里是什么样的？我在一个叫贝梅尔的地方长大。那是一个非常好的村庄。我和弟弟、哥哥以及父母一起长大。那里的生活真的很美好。您几岁开始踢足球？我五岁的时候就开始玩了。你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？起初这并不是一个真正的正式团队。我开始和我最好的两个朋友一起打球，我们每周三都训练。最终，它呼叫了F15。您第一次加入学院时几岁？我在我的乡村俱乐部 SC Bemmel 和孩子们一起踢球了 12 年。然后我加入了埃因霍温的青年队，在那里待了大约六个月，然后进入一线队。您认为迄今为止谁对您的足球生涯影响最大？迄今为止，您最大的职业亮点是什么？为国家队效力、在切尔西、在埃因霍温的时光，当然还有我在贝梅尔的早期时光。所以一切都是真的！谁是你足球界最好的朋友？我有很多朋友。在切尔西，我和丽芙、西奥和米卡关系非常密切。在切尔西之外，我还有来自埃因霍温的朋友，比如 Lisan [Alkemade]、Emma [Frijns] 和 Moon [Pondes]。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？维吉尔·范迪克是我的偶像，因为他作为中后卫的踢球风格。当然，莱昂内尔·梅西和克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多都是令人难以置信的球员，他们激励了我。在英国，他们叫我 Vee。在荷兰语中，它是 Veer 或 Veertje，这是我名字的深情版本。足球之外你最喜欢做什么？我喜欢与好人共度时光，做美好的事情。在足球之外，你总是想做一些事情，但有时当你在足球场上却做不到。也和我的家人和朋友在一起。您现在正在看什么电视剧可以推荐吗？如果我们查看您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁会主宰您播放次数最多的艺术家？我听各种各样的音乐，但奥利维亚·迪恩绝对是我的最爱之一。您最喜欢的三个度假胜地是哪些？在欧洲，我非常喜欢西班牙和意大利。我真的很想去希腊以及葡萄牙，有一天我真的很想去冲浪。如果你有客人来吃饭，你会为他们做什么菜？我可能会做一些美味的卷饼和炸玉米饼。您收到过的最好的建议是什么？从我的父母那里，就是要脚踏实地，相信自己。足球对你来说意味着什么？一切。我喜欢足球。无论场内还是场外，我都享受到很多乐趣。欢笑和享受比赛对我来说是最重要的。

news.title: What kit are Chelsea wearing against Fulham?
news.title_zh: 切尔西对阵富勒姆时穿什么球衣？
news.body_en: It's almost time for our first Premier League fixture of the new season as we prepare to take on Fulham, and it's time to find out what the Blues will be kitted out in! Chelsea are back in competitive action on Monday night with the short trip across west London to face Fulham at Craven Cottage. After an extensive pre-season programme, Xabi Alonso's side are ready for the challenge of beginning the 2026/27 campaign against our local rivals in the first of Chelsea's Premier League fixtures this season. Supporters can follow all the action from Craven Cottage across the Chelsea Official App and website, where you will find Chelsea live updates, match coverage and post-match reaction throughout the evening. Kicking off at 8pm UK time on Monday, Chelsea will be kitted out in our new 2026/27 Nike home shirt, with the Blues wearing our traditional colours for the opening Premier League fixture of the season. Central to the kit's design is the club crest, which has been refreshed and interwoven proudly in 'Bright Blue' in the fabric on the front of the shirt. There is a collar and a button-down neck, and 'Midwest Gold' accents for the rampant lion badge and Nike swoosh, which feature on both the jersey and the shorts. You can get your hands on Chelsea's home kit online and in-store right here.

news.title: Xabi Alonso backs ‘world-class’ Cole Palmer to shine this season
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索支持“世界级”科尔·帕尔默在本赛季大放异彩
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has described Cole Palmer as 'world class' and believes the forward can produce his very best football this campaign after enjoying a full pre-season under the new Chelsea head coach. Palmer heads into the new season in a strong position after spending the summer working under Alonso from day one of pre-season at Cobham, and the Blues head coach is excited by what he has seen from the attacker ahead of our Premier League opener against Fulham on Monday night. The 24-year-old has already established himself as one of the most influential attacking players in the division since arriving at Stamford Bridge, and Alonso believes the conditions are now in place for Palmer to enjoy another standout campaign. ‘Cole is determined to enjoy his football,’ said the Chelsea manager. ‘He wants to be fit. He wants to feel healthy. He wants to have a good connection with the players around him. And I've said that if we have this Cole and we are able to reach him and he feels that flow in the game and that he connects well with the players, I'm sure that his level is top-class, world-class I would say, and that he will have a great season.’ Those comments underline just how highly Alonso rates Palmer's ability, with the Spaniard confident the forward can reach the highest level when he is playing with freedom and confidence. Palmer has spent the entirety of pre-season working alongside his new head coach and team-mates, and has returned to Cobham recharged after enjoying a full off-season for the first time in four years, due to international competitions for club and country. With no international commitments during the summer, Palmer has been able to immerse himself fully in Alonso's methods from the outset, helping him build rhythm and understanding within the squad ahead of the campaign. He has also been joined by one of his closest friends in football, Morgan Rogers, following the attacking midfielder's summer arrival from Aston Villa. After seeing injuries interrupt his momentum at various stages last season, Alonso has been encouraged by Palmer's commitment to making sure those setbacks remain in the past. The Chelsea manager believes the experience has ultimately helped the attacker grow and develop a stronger understanding of his body. When asked if Cole's injury problems were behind him, Alonso replied: ‘Yes. I think that sometimes you need to go through a difficult moment with an injury or whatever to learn from that,’ 'I think that Cole has gone through a difficult period with the injury, and now he's working really hard to have the prevention not to have to feel those symptoms. ‘Since the first day, he's been working really hard to avoid that.’ Chelsea begin the Premier League season away to Fulham, and supporters can follow all the action live in our Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and website, where you'll find minute-by-minute updates and live audio commentary. Fans can also experience the matchday through the new Chelsea Official App, where we will have an ongoing story from Craven Cottage.
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索将科尔·帕尔默描述为“世界级”，并相信这位前锋在切尔西新主教练的带领下度过了完整的季前赛后，可以在本赛季打出最好的足球。帕尔默在科巴姆季前赛的第一天就在阿隆索手下工作了一个夏天，他在新赛季中处于强势地位，蓝军主教练对他在周一晚上对阵富勒姆的英超揭幕战前从这位攻击手身上看到的表现感到兴奋。自从来到斯坦福桥以来，这位 24 岁的球员已经成为了联赛中最有影响力的进攻球员之一，阿隆索相信现在条件已经具备，帕尔默可以享受另一个出色的赛季。 “科尔决心享受他的足球，”切尔西主帅说道。 “他想要保持健康。他想要感觉健康。他希望与周围的球员建立良好的联系。我说过，如果我们拥有科尔，我们能够接触到他，他能感觉到比赛的流畅性，并且他与球员之间的联系很好，我相信他的水平是顶级的，我想说的是世界一流的，他将会度过一个伟大的赛季。”这些评论强调了阿隆索对帕尔默能力的高度评价，西班牙人相信这位前锋在自由和自信地比赛时能够达到最高水平。帕尔默整个季前赛都与新任主教练和队友一起工作，由于俱乐部和国家队的国际比赛，在四年来第一次享受完整的休赛期后，他回到科巴姆恢复了活力。由于夏天没有参加国际比赛，帕尔默从一开始就能够完全沉浸在阿隆索的方法中，帮助他在赛季前建立球队的节奏和理解。摩根·罗杰斯（Morgan Rogers）是他在足球界最亲密的朋友之一，这位攻击型中场夏天从阿斯顿维拉加盟后也加入了他的行列。在看到伤病在上赛季的不同阶段打断了他的动力后，阿隆索对帕尔默确保这些挫折成为过去的承诺感到鼓舞。切尔西主帅相信这段经历最终帮助这位攻击手成长并对自己的身体有了更深入的了解。当被问及科尔的伤病问题是否已经过去时，阿隆索回答说：“是的。”我认为有时候你需要经历一个受伤的困难时刻，或者从中吸取教训，”“我认为科尔已经经历了一段受伤的困难时期，现在他正在非常努力地进行预防工作，以免感受到这些症状。 “从第一天起，他就一直在努力避免这种情况。”切尔西将在客场对阵富勒姆的英超联赛中开始，球迷们可以在切尔西官方应用程序和网站上观看比赛中心的所有比赛，在那里您可以找到每分钟的更新和现场音频评论。球迷还可以通过新的切尔西官方应用程序体验比赛日，我们将在其中播放来自 Craven Cottage 的持续故事。

news.title: Fulham vs Chelsea: All the key stats and facts
news.title_zh: 富勒姆 vs 切尔西：所有关键数据和事实
news.body_en: Chelsea begin our Premier League season with a west London derby on Monday evening. Ahead of our meeting with Fulham, we've pulled together all the vital facts, figures and statistics to get you ready for the Craven Cottage clash. Chelsea begin our Premier League season with a west London derby on Monday evening. In the match, Real Madrid's last two former managers will go head-to-head. Xabi Alonso and Alvaro Arbeloa also played together for Liverpool in nine matches against Chelsea between 2007 and 2009. This is the first time a manager’s Premier League debut has come against someone he also played alongside in the competition. Chelsea and Fulham are two of nine clubs to have new managers at the start of the Premier League season. Nine is the highest number in the competition’s history surpassing eight in 2016. The Blues (10th) and Fulham (11th) finished level on 52 points last season with only goal difference separating the sides. The Blues have won six of the past eight Premier League meetings at Craven Cottage with Fulham winning the other two. Our last draw there was in 2012. Fulham are seeking consecutive top-flight wins over Chelsea for the first time. Their only previous back-to-back victories against the Blues came between 1977 and 1979 in the Second Division. Only Man Utd (27) and Arsenal (26) have won more Premier League games against Fulham than Chelsea (23). Head-to-Head (all competitions) Chelsea 4-0 Fulham - 1925/26 & 1983/84 - both in Division Two Fulham 3-0 Chelsea - 1950/51 - FA Cup Chelsea’s biggest win at Fulham - 4-1 in 2004/05 in the Premier League Fulham’s biggest league win against Chelsea - 3-1 in 1976/77 in the Second Division This match begins the club's 35th Premier League season. We are one of six clubs to be ever-present in the competition. We have won 20 of our 34 Premier League opening-weekend matches, a win rate of 58.8 percent. Chelsea begin with six Premier League matches in London, with Everton on 17 October the first fixture requiring travel outside of the capital. Chelsea’s most recent opening-day away match was in 2022/23, when Jorginho’s penalty earned victory at Everton. That was also Chelsea’s last opening-weekend win, followed by two draws and one defeat. Xabi Alonso's first Premier League goal came against Fulham at Craven Cottage for Liverpool in October 2004. For the second season running, and the 16th time overall, we have begun a league campaign with a London derby. Twenty-seven Chelsea players have scored on their Premier League debut for the club, most recently Christopher Nkunku at Wolves in December 2023. Mick Harford was the first, against Oldham on the opening day of the inaugural Premier League season in 1992. The Blues have won four of our past five Premier League London derbies, losing the other. Reece James is the current Chelsea player with the most matchday one appearances for us in the Premier League (five). If selected, Danny Welbeck will become the first player ever to make a Premier League appearance for each of Arsenal, Chelsea and Manchester United. Finished 11th in the Premier League with 52 points. Lost 0-1 at home to Southampton in the fifth round of the FA Cup. Lost 1-2 at Newcastle in the quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup. Harry Wilson was Fulham's top scorer with 11 goals in all competitions. Fulham scored 47 Premier League goals last season, their lowest total in the competition since their 2020/21 relegation campaign, when they managed 27. Bernd Leno has played every Premier League match in each of Fulham’s past three seasons in the competition. The Cottagers have won three of their last four Premier League matches at Craven Cottage (one defeat). Fulham have won their opening game in one of their last six Premier League seasons (two draws, three defeats), beating Everton in 2023/24. They won three (Brentford, Chelsea, Tottenham) and lost three (Arsenal, Crystal Palace, West Ham) of their six home London derbies last season. The Cottagers have lost their previous three London derbies on the opening weekend of a Premier League campaign. Marco Silva left Fulham for Benfica in the summer after five seasons as head coach, following the expiry of his contract. Newly appointed head coach Alvaro Arbeloa has never managed a side against Chelsea. As a player he won two and lost four of the nine games against the Blues for Liverpool between 2007 and 2009. Wesley Fofana is suspended (two matches) following his second red card of the season against Sunderland on the final day of last season. Fulham’s Joachim Andersen is also suspended. Assistants: Adam Nunn, Dan Cook John Brooks refereed one Chelsea match last season: our January Premier League meeting with Brentford at Stamford Bridge.
news.body_zh: 切尔西将于周一晚上以西伦敦德比开始我们的英超联赛赛季。在与富勒姆的比赛之前，我们汇总了所有重要的事实、数据和统计数据，帮助您为克雷文小屋的比赛做好准备。切尔西将于周一晚上以西伦敦德比开始我们的英超联赛赛季。在这场比赛中，皇马最后两位前主帅将正面交锋。 2007 年至 2009 年间，哈维·阿隆索和阿尔瓦罗·阿贝洛亚还曾为利物浦队并肩作战过 9 场对阵切尔西队的比赛。这是主教练首次在英超联赛首秀中对阵与他在比赛中并肩作战的球员。切尔西和富勒姆是英超赛季开始时更换新主教练的九家具乐部中的两家具乐部。 9 分是这项赛事历史上最高的数字，超过 2016 年的 8 分。蓝军（第 10 位）和富勒姆（第 11 位）上赛季以 52 分持平，双方之间仅净胜球差距。过去八场在克雷文小屋举行的英超比赛中，蓝军赢了六场，富勒姆赢了另外两场。我们上一次平局是在 2012 年。富勒姆正在寻求在顶级联赛中首次连续战胜切尔西。他们之前唯一一次连续战胜蓝军是在1977年至1979年的乙级联赛中。只有曼联（27 场）和阿森纳（26 场）在对阵富勒姆的英超比赛中获胜的次数多于切尔西（23 场）。面对面（所有比赛） 切尔西 4-0 富勒姆 - 1925/26 和 1983/84 - 均在二级联赛 富勒姆 3-0 切尔西 - 1950/51 - 足总杯 切尔西在富勒姆的最大胜利 - 2004/05 英超联赛中 4-1 富勒姆对切尔西的最大联赛胜利 - 1976/77 年第二赛季 3-1联赛 这场比赛拉开了俱乐部第 35 个英超赛季的序幕。我们是参加比赛的六支球队之一。我们在 34 场英超联赛揭幕周末比赛中赢了 20 场，胜率为 58.8%。切尔西将在伦敦开始六场英超比赛，其中 10 月 17 日对阵埃弗顿是首场需要前往伦敦以外的地方进行的比赛。切尔西最近一场揭幕战客场比赛是在2022/23赛季，当时若日尼奥的点球帮助埃弗顿获胜。这也是切尔西在开幕周末取得的最后一场胜利，随后是两平一负。哈维·阿隆索的第一个英超联赛进球是 2004 年 10 月代表利物浦在克雷文小屋对阵富勒姆的比赛中打进的。连续第二个赛季，也是第 16 次，我们以伦敦德比开始了联赛。共有 27 名切尔西球员在俱乐部的英超首秀中取得进球，最近一次是 2023 年 12 月克里斯托弗·恩昆库 (Christopher Nkunku) 在狼队的比赛中取得进球。米克·哈福德 (Mick Harford) 是第一个进球，他是在 1992 年英超联赛首个赛季的揭幕战对阵奥尔德姆 (Oldham) 的比赛中取得进球。在过去五场英超伦敦德比中，蓝军赢了四场，输掉了另一场。里斯·詹姆斯是目前在英超联赛中出场次数最多的切尔西球员（五次）。如果入选，丹尼·维尔贝克将成为第一位代表阿森纳、切尔西和曼联参加英超联赛的球员。积52分排名英超第11位。足总杯第五轮主场0-1不敌南安普顿。联赛杯四分之一决赛1-2不敌纽卡斯尔联。哈里·威尔逊 (Harry Wilson) 在所有比赛中攻入 11 粒进球，成为富勒姆队内的最佳射手。富勒姆上赛季在英超联赛中打入 47 个进球，这是自 2020/21 赛季降级以来的最低进球数，当时他们只打进了 27 个英超进球。贝恩德·莱诺在富勒姆过去三个赛季的英超联赛中都参加了所有比赛。小屋队在克雷文小屋的过去四场英超比赛中赢了三场（一场失败）。富勒姆在过去六个英超赛季中的一个赛季中赢得了首场比赛（2平3负），并在2023/24赛季击败了埃弗顿。上赛季他们在六场主场伦敦德比中赢了三场（布伦特福德、切尔西、托特纳姆热刺），输了三场（阿森纳、水晶宫、西汉姆联）。小屋队在英超联赛首周末输掉了前三场伦敦德比。马尔科·席尔瓦在担任主教练五个赛季后，在合同到期后于今年夏天离开富勒姆加盟本菲卡。新任主教练阿尔瓦罗·阿贝洛亚从未执教过球队对阵切尔西。作为一名球员，他在2007年至2009年间代表利物浦对阵蓝军的九场比赛中取得了两胜四负的成绩。 韦斯利·福法纳在上赛季最后一天对阵桑德兰的比赛中吃到本赛季第二张红牌后被停赛（两场比赛）。富勒姆队的约阿希姆·安德森也被停赛。助理裁判：亚当·纳恩、丹·库克、约翰·布鲁克斯上赛季执法了一场切尔西比赛：我们一月份在斯坦福桥对阵布伦特福德的英超联赛。

news.title: Lacroix looking forward to start of a ‘beautiful season’
news.title_zh: 拉克鲁瓦期待“美丽赛季”的开始
news.body_en: Maxence Lacroix can’t wait for his first season as a Chelsea player to begin and is hopeful of making it a memorable one for Blues supporters. Following his summer move across the capital from fellow Premier League side Crystal Palace, Lacroix made his first outing for Chelsea in last weekend’s friendly win over Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge. That was our final pre-season fixture before the real action begins with our Premier League opener away at neighbours Fulham on Monday evening. Having got his first taste of the action with his introduction to the Blues fans, our new defender can’t wait to get started in his first competitive match. ‘I really enjoyed my first game,’ said Lacroix. ‘I really enjoyed wearing the Chelsea jersey and also being in front of the fans. It was a good moment and we got a win, which was perfect for me! ‘I think everyone is looking forward to Monday and we have a big season in front of us, and it's starting in just a couple of days. ‘Of course, I know all about London derbies and Fulham. I knew them also with Palace, but I know that now with Chelsea, with this big club, it's also totally different, and I'm looking forward to all these derbies.’ Lacroix was one of the late-comers to pre-season training at Chelsea, after being part of the France side which reached the semi-finals of the FIFA World Cup over the summer. However, he has quickly settled in to his new surroundings and is already well accustomed to switching between defensive shapes, with Xabi Alonso having used both a back three and a back four during pre-season ‘I’ve settled in well, it’s been really good working with the manager and the other players,’ he added. ‘It’s really good. All the guys are good and it’s been top training with them every day. ‘I've played back three and I've played back four at Wolfsburg, at Palace and also in the national team. So for me it's all right for both tactics. ‘I think it’s important for any player to be able to play different ways. And also to understand how we want to play, that is always important for me.’ That leaves Lacroix ready and eager for the start of the 2026/27 season, which he hopes will be one to celebrate for those on the pitch and in the stands. ‘The big message for the fans is that it's going to be a beautiful season and we need you with us so we can enjoy it together.’
news.body_zh: 马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 迫不及待地等待他作为切尔西球员的第一个赛季的开始，并希望让这个赛季成为蓝军球迷难忘的一个赛季。继夏季从英超球队水晶宫转会至首都后，拉克鲁瓦在上周末在斯坦福桥战胜皇家社会的友谊赛中首次代表切尔西出场。这是我们在周一晚上客场对阵邻国富勒姆的英超首场比赛开始之前的最后一场季前赛。我们的新后卫在向蓝军球迷介绍后第一次尝到了比赛的滋味，他迫不及待地想开始他的第一场正式比赛。 “我真的很喜欢我的第一场比赛，”拉克鲁瓦说。 “我真的很喜欢穿着切尔西球衣，也很喜欢站在球迷面前。这是一个美好的时刻，我们取得了胜利，这对我来说是完美的！ “我想每个人都在期待周一的到来，我们面前有一个重要的赛季，而且几天后就要开始了。 “当然，我了解伦敦德比和富勒姆的一切。我在水晶宫也认识他们，但我知道现在在切尔西，在这家大俱乐部，情况也完全不同，我期待着所有这些德比。”拉克鲁瓦是切尔西季前训练的后来者之一，此前他曾随法国队进入今年夏天的世界杯半决赛。然而，他很快就适应了新的环境，并且已经很好地习惯了防守阵型之间的转换，哈维·阿隆索在季前赛中同时使用了三后卫和四后卫。“我已经适应得很好，与主教练和其他球员的合作非常好，”他补充道。 ‘真是太好了。所有的球员都很棒，每天和他们一起训练都是顶级的。 “我在沃尔夫斯堡、水晶宫和国家队踢过三场比赛和四场比赛。所以对我来说这两种策略都可以。 “我认为对于任何球员来说，能够以不同的方式打球都很重要。而且了解我们想要如何比赛，这对我来说始终很重要。”这让拉克鲁瓦做好了准备，并渴望 2026/27 赛季的开始，他希望这将是球场上和看台上的人们庆祝的一个。 “对球迷来说，最重要的信息是，这将是一个美好的赛季，我们需要你们和我们在一起，这样我们才能一起享受它。”

news.title: Under-18s report: Birmingham 1-4 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 18岁以下青年队报告：伯明翰1-4切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s secured our first points of the new Under-18 Premier League campaign with a convincing 4-1 victory away to Birmingham City. The Blues made a fast start in the West Midlands, with first-year scholar Isaac McGillvary opening the scoring after seven minutes. Heze Grimwade doubled our advantage shortly before half-time, however Birmingham were given a route back into the contest when Connor Reilly pulled a goal back just before the interval. The points were secured in the second half though, with Andrew Pennie netting a brace and securing our fine win. Chelsea took the lead in the seventh minute through McGillvary. The first-year produced a composed finish, taking one touch before finding the net to put the visitors 1-0 ahead. The young Blues continued to hold the advantage as the first half progressed and extended it five minutes before the break. Grimwade took a good touch before finishing neatly to make it 2-0, putting us in a strong position heading into the closing stages of the half. Birmingham responded immediately before the interval, with Reilly finishing well following a surging run from Blake Campbell, to reduce the deficit to 2-1 at half-time. Chelsea restored our two-goal advantage midway through the second half. Josh Henry produced the work which created the opening for Pennie, who was in the right place to finish and make it 3-1. Pennie struck again 10 minutes later to complete his brace. The ball dropped kindly for the forward and he made no mistake, giving the Blues a three-goal cushion. Pennie, who had been shifted from centre-forward to the left, continued to provide a threat and played a key role in our victory. There was still time for the visitors to threaten again. Jacob Dako saw a left-footed effort from outside the box blocked in the 77th minute, before Yunus Linton tried his luck from more than 35 yards six minutes later but fired over as the Blues saw out the game well. The result gives Chelsea our first points of the 2026/27 Under-18 Premier League campaign, following defeat to Norwich City in our opening fixture. Our Under-18s return to action on Wednesday when we play Wolverhampton Wanderers in the U18 Premier League Cup, in a 2pm kick-off. We will then be back at Cobham on Saturday 29 August when we host Reading in the Under-18 Premier League. That game will start at 11am. news.body_zh: 切尔西 U-18 队客场以 4-1 令人信服地战胜伯明翰城，取得了新一届 U-18 英超联赛的首个积分。蓝军在西米德兰兹开局很快，七分钟后一年级学生艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里首开纪录。半场结束前不久，赫泽格里姆韦德将我们的优势扩大了一倍，但在中场休息前康纳赖利扳回一球，伯明翰队获得了重返比赛的机会。不过，下半场我们锁定了分数，安德鲁·彭尼梅开二度，确保了我们的精彩胜利。第7分钟，切尔西通过麦吉尔瓦里取得领先。第一年的球队表现镇定自若，触球一脚破门，客队1-0领先。随着上半场的进展，年轻的蓝军继续保持优势，并在中场休息前五分钟将优势扩大。格里姆韦德在漂亮的射门后将比分改写为2-0，让我们在半场最后阶段处于有利地位。伯明翰队在中场休息前立即作出回应，赖利在布雷克·坎贝尔的冲球后出色完成了比赛，半场结束时将比分差距缩小到2-1。下半场中段，切尔西恢复了两球优势。乔什·亨利 (Josh Henry) 的进球为彭尼 (Pennie) 创造了开局，后者在正确的位置完成射门，将比分改写为 3-1。 10分钟后，彭尼再次进球，完成梅开二度。球落到这位前锋身上，他没有犯错，为蓝军取得了三球的缓冲。从中锋转移到左路的彭尼继续提供威胁，并在我们的胜利中发挥了关键作用。客队还有时间再次威胁。第77分钟，雅各布·达科(Jacob Dako)禁区外的左脚射门被挡出，六分钟后，尤努斯·林顿(Yunus Linton)在35码外尝试运气，但射门高出，蓝军很好地控制了比赛。这一结果为切尔西带来了 2026/27 年 18 岁以下英超联赛的首个积分，此前我们在首场比赛中输给了诺维奇城。我们的 18 岁以下青年队将于周三恢复比赛，我们将在 U18 英超联赛杯中对阵狼队，比赛将于下午 2 点开球。我们将于 8 月 29 日星期六回到科巴姆，届时我们将在 18 岁以下英超联赛中主场迎战雷丁。这场比赛将于上午 11 点开始。切尔西：贝尔；桑布、霍尔、达席尔瓦（Silva 74）、韦特；亨利·格里姆韦德（林顿 77）、达科；麦吉尔瓦里（安德森 77）、格林伍德（法罗莫-阿德巴约 67）、彭尼（安帕 77）未上场替补：穆雷、马伦达马得分手：麦吉尔瓦里 7、格里姆韦德 40、彭尼 66、75 伯明翰城：史密斯；皮尔索尔、霍克斯伍德、麦考蒂、查哈尔；布莱克-坎贝尔、格里尔（泰勒 59）、齐奥尔科夫斯基（尼尔 81）、霍劳、梅森（努内斯-威克姆 59）、赖利。未上场替补：沃森、德拉梅得分：赖利 45 黄牌：坎贝尔 53

news.title: Joao Pedro picks his five special moments with Chelsea
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗挑选了他在切尔西的五个特殊时刻
news.body_en: Joao Pedro wasted no time making his mark during his first year at Chelsea, and after signing a new contract with the club, he has selected his favourite moments with the Blues so far. The Brazilian arrived from Brighton and Hove Albion last summer and went straight into the action as we triumphed at the FIFA Club World Cup in the USA. He then became a central figure in the team throughout the 2025/26 campaign. That contribution has been rewarded with a new contract until 2034 for the striker, who celebrated by choosing five of the games for Chelsea which have meant the most to him in his Blues career to date… I think in my first game, I was feeling very happy against Palmeiras, about making my debut. Like I said when we were on tour in Asia and Australia this summer, I didn't know before that Chelsea had a lot of fans in other countries like that. When I joined in America, I could see the passion they have for this club there. When I made my debut everyone was saying to me: "Congratulations, you’re very welcome here,". So I think my debut was very important for me. My first goal with Chelsea was against Fluminense, where I started my career. It was the first time since I moved to England that I played against them, so I got to see a few of my friends from when I was young, that I used to play with. So it was special for me, not to score against them specifically, but to achieve that moment. I was arriving at a big club. What I was doing – scoring my first goals for a big club against the team that gave me a lot – felt special. So I think that moment means a lot to me. The final of the Club World Cup was a special moment. We knew the game would be difficult because Paris Saint-Germain won the Champions League and everything. But I think Cole had a special day. Me also, as I could score and I could help the team. I think at the back we are solid as well. So I think that day was Chelsea’s day. Everything was perfect and we could win. It was a very special moment for me. It was my first trophy as a professional player, so I cannot leave that out from my five best moments at Chelsea. Tottenham away was a great win with the fans in a derby atmosphere, and I got the winning goal. It was also because when I was at Brighton, I had lots of good moments against them too, so I enjoyed playing against Tottenham. Now I am at Chelsea and I know the rivalry is very big with Tottenham, so scoring the winning goal was even better, and it was a nice moment to celebrate with the fans after winning a derby. Against Napoli, I scored twice in the Champions League for the first time and I did it in a big game and a big atmosphere, which made it even more special. For me, to play in the Champions League is very important for me, because when I was young I always dreamed of playing for a big club and playing in big Champions League games. So scoring that winning goal for Chelsea was an important moment, not just for me, but I think for Chelsea too, because we had too many games and if we won that game we would finish high enough in the classification to qualify straight for the last 16.
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗在切尔西的第一年就没有浪费时间留下自己的印记，在与俱乐部签订新合同后，他选择了迄今为止他在蓝军最喜欢的时刻。这位巴西人去年夏天从布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩来到这里，并在我们赢得美国国际足联俱乐部世界杯的比赛中直接投入到比赛中。随后他成为球队整个2025/26赛季的核心人物。这一贡献得到了这位前锋的新合同的回报，直到2034年，他为切尔西选择了五场比赛来庆祝，这对他迄今为止的蓝军生涯来说意义重大……我想在我的第一场比赛中，我对对阵帕尔梅拉斯的首秀感到非常高兴。就像我今年夏天在亚洲和澳大利亚巡演时所说的那样，我之前并不知道切尔西在其他国家有很多球迷。当我加入美国时，我可以看到他们对那里的俱乐部的热情。当我首次亮相时，每个人都对我说：“恭喜你，这里非常欢迎你”。所以我认为我的首秀对我来说非常重要。我在切尔西的第一个进球是对阵弗鲁米嫩塞，我在那里开始了我的职业生涯。这是我搬到英格兰后第一次和他们比赛，所以我见到了一些小时候一起踢球的朋友。所以这对我来说很特别，不是专门针对他们得分，而是实现那一刻。我正要到达一家大俱乐部。我所做的事情——为一家大俱乐部打入我的第一个进球，对阵这支给了我很多的球队——感觉很特别。所以我认为那一刻对我来说意义重大。世俱杯决赛是一个特殊的时刻。我们知道这场比赛会很困难，因为巴黎圣日耳曼赢得了冠军联赛和一切。但我认为科尔度过了特别的一天。我也是，因为我可以得分，我可以帮助球队。我认为我们的后防线也很稳固。所以我认为那一天是切尔西的一天。一切都很完美，我们可以获胜。这对我来说是一个非常特别的时刻。这是我作为职业球员的第一座奖杯，所以我不能在我在切尔西的五个最佳时刻中忽略这一点。客场对阵托特纳姆热刺，在德比气氛中与球迷一起取得了一场伟大的胜利，我打进了制胜球。也是因为当我在布莱顿的时候，我也有很多对阵他们的美好时刻，所以我很享受对阵热刺的比赛。现在我在切尔西，我知道与托特纳姆热刺的竞争非常激烈，所以打进制胜球就更好了，这是在赢得德比后与球迷一起庆祝的美好时刻。对阵那不勒斯，我第一次在欧冠联赛中梅开二度，而且是在一场重要的比赛和盛大的气氛中完成的，这使得它变得更加特别。对我来说，参加欧冠对我来说非常重要，因为当我年轻的时候，我一直梦想着为一家大俱乐部效力，参加欧冠的大型比赛。因此，为切尔西打进制胜一球是一个重要的时刻，不仅对我来说，我认为对切尔西来说也是如此，因为我们有太多比赛了，如果我们赢了那场比赛，我们将在排名中获得足够高的排名，从而直接晋级 16 强。

news.title: Xabi Alonso thrilled ‘great personality’ Joao Pedro has signed new contract
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索对“伟大人物”若昂·佩德罗签下新合同感到兴奋
news.body_en: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso has spoken of his delight at seeing ‘leader’ Joao Pedro commit his long-term future to Chelsea. On the eve of our latest Premier League campaign – which starts on Monday evening with a London derby away to Fulham – the Brazilian penned fresh terms with the Blues that will keep him at Stamford Bridge until 2034. And with the No.9 on his back for the season ahead, last season’s top scorer will be aiming to reach similar heights under Alonso, who has been delighted with the way the striker has applied himself in pre-season. ‘We talk a lot with Joao because he's not just a great player, but also a great person,’ Alonso said of the Brazilian international. ‘He has a great personality within the group. ‘I think that his development as a great player and as a leader is very noticeable every day, and in each game. He has this focus and this desire to have a great season, to score goals, but he is also focused on helping the team. ‘I'm very happy with Joao and with this news [signing a new contract]. I'm very impressed with his personality and now we need to help him in reaching his goals.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西主教练哈维·阿隆索表示，他很高兴看到“领袖”若昂·佩德罗将自己的长期未来奉献给切尔西。在我们最新的英超联赛前夕——周一晚上客场对阵富勒姆的伦敦德比开始——这位巴西人与蓝军签订了新的合同，这将使他在斯坦福桥效力到2034年。在接下来的赛季中，这位9号球员将背负着他，上赛季的最佳射手将在阿隆索的带领下达到类似的高度，他对这位前锋在季前赛中的表现感到高兴。 “我们和若奥谈了很多，因为他不仅是一名伟大的球员，而且也是一个伟大的人，”阿隆索谈到这位巴西国脚时说道。 “他在团队中很有个性。 “我认为他作为一名伟大球员和领袖的进步在每一天、每场比赛中都是非常引人注目的。他有这样的专注力和渴望度过一个伟大的赛季，进球，但他也专注于帮助球队。 “我对若昂和这个消息（签署新合同）感到非常满意。他的个性给我留下了深刻的印象，现在我们需要帮助他实现他的目标。

news.title: Joao Pedro signs new Chelsea contract
news.title_zh: 若昂·佩德罗与切尔西续约
news.body_en: Chelsea is delighted to announce that Joao Pedro has signed a new contract until 2034. The Brazil international joined the Blues in July 2025 and made an immediate impact, scoring in the Club World Cup semi-finals and final as we were crowned world champions. Joao Pedro continued to be decisive in his first full season as a Chelsea player. He netted 20 goals in all competitions and ended the 2025/26 campaign as our supporters’ Player of the Season. ‘I am very happy to sign a new contract with Chelsea,’ Joao Pedro said. ‘I always dreamed of playing for a big club, and it means a lot to me to give my long-term commitment to this club. Chelsea has a long tradition of winning and it has big ambitions for the future. ‘I have a very good relationship with everyone here at the club and I have felt at home here in London from the moment that I joined. 'Everyone is very excited for this season. We know we can achieve a lot of things, we have a great team, we have a coach who wants to win and has won already. I am fully committed, everyone is ready and hopefully we can achieve our targets.' Signed from Brighton and Hove Albion, Joao Pedro quickly delivered for the Blues. He struck a brace against former club Fluminense to help us into the Club World Cup final, and then netted in our victory over Paris Saint-Germain as we claimed the trophy. His goalscoring form continued into his first full campaign in blue. He netted our opening goal of the 2025/26 season, away at West Ham United, and later scored the only goal in an away win over Tottenham Hotspur. Our new No.9 also had an impact on the European stage, with a fine brace netted in a victory over Napoli in the UEFA Champions League. Joao Pedro ended the campaign with 20 goals scored for the Blues, which saw him overwhelming voted as our Player of the Season. Congratulations on your new contract, JP!
news.body_zh: 切尔西很高兴地宣布若奥·佩德罗已签下一份新合同，有效期至 2034 年。这位巴西国脚于 2025 年 7 月加盟蓝军，并立即产生了影响，在世俱杯半决赛和决赛中进球，帮助我们加冕世界冠军。若昂·佩德罗在作为切尔西球员的第一个完整赛季中继续发挥着决定性作用。他在所有比赛中攻入 20 个进球，并在 2025/26 赛季结束时成为我们球迷评选的赛季最佳球员。 “我很高兴与切尔西签订新合同，”若昂·佩德罗说道。 “我一直梦想为一家大俱乐部效力，对这个俱乐部做出长期承诺对我来说意义重大。切尔西有着悠久的获胜传统，并且对未来抱有远大的抱负。 “我和俱乐部里的每个人都保持着非常好的关系，从加入伦敦的那一刻起，我就在伦敦感受到了宾至如归的感觉。 “每个人都对这个赛季感到非常兴奋。我们知道我们可以取得很多成就，我们有一支伟大的团队，我们有一位想要获胜并且已经获胜的教练。我完全投入，每个人都准备好了，希望我们能够实现我们的目标。”从布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩签下的若奥·佩德罗很快就为蓝军做出了贡献。他在对阵老东家弗鲁米嫩塞的比赛中梅开二度，帮助我们进入世俱杯决赛，然后在我们战胜巴黎圣日耳曼队的比赛中攻入一球，帮助我们夺得了奖杯。他的进球状态一直持续到他的第一个完整的蓝色赛季。他在我们2025/26赛季客场对阵西汉姆联的比赛中攻入首球，随后又在客场战胜托特纳姆热刺的比赛中攻入唯一进球。我们的新9号也在欧洲舞台上产生了影响，在欧洲冠军联赛战胜那不勒斯的比赛中梅开二度。若昂·佩德罗为蓝军攻入 20 个进球，以压倒性优势当选本赛季最佳球员。恭喜你获得新合同，JP！

news.body_en: Fresh from signing an extension to his Chelsea contract, Joao Pedro said feeling ‘at home’ made it an easy decision to commit his future to the Blues. Chelsea has a long tradition of winning and it has big ambitions for the future. ‘I have a very good relationship with everyone here at the club and I have felt at home from the moment that I joined. ‘I had a great season last season and I think we have built a good team. Xabi spoke with me, we had good conversations and I’m excited to play for him. I think this is the right moment [to sign a new contract] and hopefully it can be a very exciting year for us. ‘The fans have been amazing with me, we’ve had a fantastic 12 months already and I feel at home. I’m very happy to be here and to stay with Chelsea.’
news.body_zh: 若昂·佩德罗刚刚与切尔西续签合同，他表示“宾至如归”的感觉让他很容易就决定将自己的未来奉献给蓝军。巴西人已经签署了一份让他在斯坦福桥效力到2034年的合同，这位前锋已经向切尔西频道独家透露了延长他在蓝军效力的“简单决定”——我们的9号球员还解释说，与新主帅哈维·阿隆索的一次谈话也影响了他的决定。 “我很高兴与切尔西签订新合同，”若昂·佩德罗说道。 “我一直梦想为一家大俱乐部效力，对这个俱乐部做出长期承诺对我来说意义重大。切尔西有着悠久的获胜传统，并且对未来抱有远大的抱负。 “我和俱乐部里的每个人都保持着非常好的关系，从加入那一刻起我就有宾至如归的感觉。 “上赛季我度过了一个很棒的赛季，我认为我们已经组建了一支优秀的球队。哈维和我进行了交谈，我们进行了很好的交谈，我很高兴能为他效力。我认为现在是[签署新合同]的正确时机，希望这对我们来说是非常激动人心的一年。 “球迷们对我来说太棒了，我们已经度过了美妙的 12 个月，我有宾至如归的感觉。我很高兴来到这里并留在切尔西。”

news.title: Alonso on Palestra: 'He's something different'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索谈帕莱斯特拉：“他与众不同”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes Marco Palestra’s talent, versatility and personality will make him an important asset for Chelsea throughout the 2026/27 campaign. Palestra joined the Blues this summer from Atalanta after being named Serie A's standout defender following a breakthrough season on loan at Cagliari. Palestra showcased his all-round ability as a full-back and a wing-back with the Sardinian club. But perhaps most impressively, he excelled on either side of the pitch to the extent many found it impossible to tell which was his preferred flank or stronger foot. That is a rare talent even at the top level of the game in England, as Alonso discussed when facing the media ahead of Monday night’s opening Chelsea fixture of the season away at Fulham. ‘I would say it's probably unusual in England because, in Italy for example, it's quite common, and he has had this education in Italian football to play both profiles,’ explained Xabi. ‘It doesn't matter if you are right-footed or left-footed, just that you are versatile. So he has this option, this energy. ‘He's something different, maybe not that common here, but in Italy it's quite common.’ However, it is not just Palestra’s versatility on the pitch which has impressed our manager, with the Spaniard quick to highlight the personality the defender has brought to Cobham and the positive effect he is already having on the squad before his competitive debut for the Blues. ‘He's had a great impact as well in the changing room,’ Alonso added. ‘He's integrated really well. He's a great guy and with this freshness that he has brought, apart from his football qualities, he's a very great addition to the club.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索相信马尔科·帕莱斯特拉的天赋、多才多艺和个性将使他成为切尔西整个 2026/27 赛季的重要资产。帕莱斯特拉在租借到卡利亚里度过了突破性的赛季后，被评为意甲杰出后卫，今年夏天从亚特兰大加盟蓝军。帕莱斯特拉在撒丁岛俱乐部展示了他作为边后卫和边后卫的全能能力。但也许最令人印象深刻的是，他在球场的两侧都表现出色，以至于许多人发现无法分辨他更喜欢哪一侧或更强的脚。即使在英格兰顶级联赛中，这也是一位罕见的天才，正如阿隆索在周一晚上切尔西客场对阵富勒姆的本赛季首场比赛之前面对媒体时所讨论的那样。 “我想说这在英格兰可能不寻常，因为在意大利，这很常见，而且他接受过意大利足球教育，可以踢这两种职业，”哈维解释道。 ‘无论你是右脚还是左脚并不重要，重要的是你是多才多艺的。所以他有这个选择，这个能量。 “他是个与众不同的人，也许在这里并不常见，但在意大利却很常见。”然而，给我们主教练留下深刻印象的不仅仅是帕莱斯特拉在球场上的多才多艺，这位西班牙人很快就强调了这名后卫给科巴姆带来的个性，以及他在为蓝军上演首秀之前就已经给球队带来的积极影响。 “他在更衣室里也产生了巨大的影响，”阿隆索补充道。 ‘他融入得非常好。他是一个很棒的人，除了他的足球能力之外，他还带来了新鲜感，他对俱乐部来说是一个非常好的补充。”
